questions.text: What has been the most dominant passion of the human race during the last three centuries?
options: Discovery of fresh fields and new pastures in the field of intellect
Gaining freedom in different spheres of life

options: Achievement of the human race in science and technology

questions.text: Amy: “I am so excited! My sister is coming back to India for Diwali and the whole family will be together for a great celebration on Diwali day.”

Is Diwali a big deal in India?
It's just great to have her back at this time and have all the family together for the festival.

questions.text: When you enter into an office, you notice a sign that reads: “Do not adjust the fan speed without Mr. Sharma's permission.” Reading this, what impression would you form of the office?

It is a controlled but a collaborative work environment.

questions.text: You went shopping with your sister and mother and in the shopping complex you notice that some anti-social elements have been following you all for some time. How will you respond?
options: You will call your friends and ask them to come immediately.
You will leave the shopping complex very watchfully.
You will spot a beat constable and seek his help.

questions.text: At a traffic signal someone accidentally hits your car from behind, and the car bumper gets dislodged. How will you react?
options: You will get out and approach him threateningly.
You will get out, look at the damage and assess it before you say anything.
You will immediately confront and seek compensation.
You will assess the damage and then ask him to get it repaired.

questions.text: In a departmental meeting, your Head scolds you in front of everyone for an error that your colleague committed. How will you respond?
options: You will stand up and tell him that it was your colleague and not you.
You will keep quiet but after the meeting you will tell him that it was your colleague and not you.
You will hear him out knowing that the scolding is misplaced.
You will leave the meeting as a gesture of protest.

questions.text: It is exam time and your friend requests you for some notes. How will you respond?
options: Sorry, I am using it so I cannot give it to you right now.
I understand your need, but I am using those notes now.
Are you out of your mind, asking notes at this time?
